SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , t1.TR_CD AS trCd , t1.BALH_CO AS balhCo , jb.BALH_NM AS balhNm , jb.BALH_NM AS xxBalhCo , t1.BAED_MTH AS baedMth , t1.BAEJ_MTH AS baejMth , t1.CASH_ILBAN_RT AS cashIlbanRt , t1.CASH_WOOS_RT AS cashWoosRt , t1.STOCK_ILBAN_RT AS stockIlbanRt , t1.STOCK_WOOS_RT AS stockWoosRt , TO_CHAR(t1.BROK_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS brokYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.JUCHONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS juchongYmd , CASE WHEN t1.stock_woos_rt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE t1.stock_woos_rt * 100 END AS stockWoosPer , CASE WHEN t1.stock_ilban_rt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE t1.stock_ilban_rt * 100 END AS stockIlbanPer , CASE WHEN t1.cash_woos_rt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE t1.cash_woos_rt * 100 END AS cashWoosPer , CASE WHEN t1.cash_ilban_rt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE t1.cash_ilban_rt * 100 END AS cashIlbanPer , t1.ILBAN_AEK AS ilbanAek , t1.WOOS_AEK AS woosAek FROM SJT0BK t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.BALH_CO = t1.BALH_CO WHERE 1=1
AND t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr}
AND t1.corp_gr = '%'
AND t1.TR_YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM')) AND t1.TR_CD = 'G10' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SZX0AA aa WHERE aa.customer_gr = #{customerGr}) ORDER BY t1.balh_co ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , t1.TR_CD AS trCd , t1.BALH_CO AS balhCo , t1.JM_CD AS jjCd , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.CASH_RT AS cashRt , t1.STOCK_RT AS stockRt , t1.BAED_AEK AS baedAek , t1.cash_rt * 100 AS cashPer , t1.stock_rt * 100 AS stockPer , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS xxJjCd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS jmNm FROM SJT0BJ t1 WHERE 1=1
AND t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr}
AND t1.corp_gr LIKE '%'
AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND t1.BALH_CO = #{balhCo} ORDER BY t1.jm_cd ASC
SELECT jm.JM_CD AS jjCd , jm.JM_CD AS jmCd , jm.JJ_NM AS xxJjCd , jm.JJ_NM AS jmNm FROM SJM0JJ jm WHERE jm.balh_co = #{balhCo} AND jm.danc_gb IN ('A', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY jm.jm_cd DESC

TO_CHAR(bk.JUCHONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bkJuchongYmd , bk.ILBAN_AEK AS bkIlbanAek , bk.WOOS_AEK AS bkWoosAek , jb.BALH_NM AS balhNm , jb.BALH_NM AS xxBalhCo , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.stock_woos_rt,0) != NVL(bk.stock_woos_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.stock_ilban_rt,0) != NVL(bk.stock_ilban_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.cash_woos_rt,0) != NVL(bk.cash_woos_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.cash_ilban_rt,0) != NVL(bk.cash_ilban_rt,0) THEN 255 ELSE (SELECT balh_co FROM SJT0BM ta WHERE ta.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND ta.ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM'))) ORDER BY bk.balh_co ASC

TO_CHAR(bk.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bkTrYmd , bk.TR_CD AS bkTrCd , bk.BALH_CO AS bkBalhCo , bk.BAED_MTH AS bkBaedMth , bk.BAEJ_MTH AS bkBaejMth , bk.CASH_ILBAN_RT AS bkCashIlbanRt , bk.CASH_WOOS_RT AS bkCashWoosRt , bk.STOCK_ILBAN_RT AS bkStockIlbanRt , bk.STOCK_WOOS_RT AS bkStockWoosRt , bk.stock_woos_rt * 100 AS bkStockWoosPer , bk.stock_ilban_rt * 100 AS bkStockIlbanPer , bk.cash_woos_rt * 100 AS bkCashWoosPer , bk.cash_ilban_rt * 100 AS bkCashIlbanPer , TO_CHAR(bk.BROK_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bkBrokYmd , TO_CHAR(bk.JUCHONG_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bkJuchongYmd , bk.ILBAN_AEK AS bkIlbanAek , bk.WOOS_AEK AS bkWoosAek , jb.BALH_NM AS balhNm , jb.BALH_NM AS xxBalhCo , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD') THEN 1 WHEN t1.tr_ymd IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 9 END AS trSort , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.stock_woos_rt,0) != NVL(bk.stock_woos_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.stock_ilban_rt,0) != NVL(bk.stock_ilban_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.cash_woos_rt,0) != NVL(bk.cash_woos_rt,0) OR NVL(t1.cash_ilban_rt,0) != NVL(bk.cash_ilban_rt,0) THEN 255 ELSE 2960685 END AS fontColor , CASE WHEN t1.tr_ymd >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{workDate}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') OR t1.corp_gr IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pVisible , CASE WHEN NVL(tt.jm_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS pSjt0bj FROM SJT0BK bk LEFT OUTER JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.BALH_CO = bk.BALH_CO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT sub_t1.* FROM (SELECT g1.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY balh_co, brok_ymd, baed_mth, baej_mth ORDER BY tr_ymd DESC) AS rnum FROM SJT0BK g1 WHERE g1.corp_gr = '%' AND g1.TR_CD = 'G20') sub_t1 WHERE sub_t1.rnum = 1) t1 ON t1.balh_co = bk.balh_co AND t1.brok_ymd = bk.brok_ymd AND t1.baed_mth = bk.baed_mth AND t1.baej_mth = bk.baej_mth LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT tr_ymd , balh_co , COUNT(*) AS jm_cnt FROM SJT0BJ p1 WHERE corp_gr = '%' AND tr_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM') AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{workDate}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND tr_cd = 'G20' AND cash_rt > 0 GROUP BY tr_ymd, balh_co) tt ON tt.tr_ymd = t1.tr_ymd AND tt.balh_co = t1.balh_co WHERE bk.corp_gr = '%' AND bk.TR_YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM')) AND bk.balh_co IN (SELECT ta.balh_co FROM SJT0BM ta JOIN SZX0AA aa ON aa.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr WHERE ta.ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ym}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMM')) AND aa.customer_gr = #{customerGr}) AND bk.TR_CD = 'G10' ORDER BY trSort ASC, trYmd DESC, baejMth ASC, balhCo ASC

AND t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr}
AND t1.corp_gr LIKE '%'
AND aa.customer_gr = #{customerGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{brokYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.BALH_CO = #{balhCo} ORDER BY t1.corp_gr ASC, t1.fund_cd ASC
